Description
Founded in 1850, Sydney is Australia's first university and is regarded as one of the world's leading institutions. Its campus, spreading across the inner-city suburbs of Camperdown and Darlington, is ranked in the top 10 of the world's most beautiful universities by the British Daily Telegraph and the American The Huffington Post. The QS World University Rankings ranked Sydney as one of the world's top 25 most reputable universities, and its graduates as the top 5 most employable in the world and first in Australia.
The Foundation program leads to a wide range of undergraduate degrees at the University of Sydney upon successful completion of the course.
